steps.title: Welcome to Your First Class
body: Chinese is not written with letters, but with characters. So how do we know how to pronounce 你好? The answer is pinyin: the official romanization system of Mandarin Chinese.
Pinyin uses the Latin alphabet to represent the sounds of Chinese. It is not a translation or a language: it is a pronunciation guide that will accompany you throughout your entire learning journey.

steps.title: Lesson Objectives
body: Understand what pinyin is and what it is used for.
Learn the structure of a Chinese syllable: initial + final + tone.
Read your first syllables in pinyin.

steps.title: The Chinese Syllable
body: Every Chinese syllable has up to three parts: an initial (consonant), a final (vowel or vowel group), and a tone.
For example, in «mā» (妈, mom): the initial is «m», the final is «a», and the tone is the first tone, marked by the horizontal line above the vowel.

Mandarin Chinese has 21 initials and about 36 finals. Combined with tones, they produce around 1,300 possible syllables — far fewer than the number of words. That is why tones are essential: they distinguish words that would otherwise sound the same.

steps.title: The Classic Example: ma
body: The syllable «ma» can mean completely different things depending on the tone: mā (妈, mother), má (麻, hemp), mǎ (马, horse), mà (骂, scold), and ma (吗, question particle).
Listen to each one with the audio button and notice how the melody of the syllable changes. Do not worry about producing them yet: first, your ear.

options.label: A writing system that replaces characters
A pronunciation guide using the Latin alphabet
The name of the ancient Chinese alphabet

exercise.explanation: Pinyin does not replace characters: it is the official tool to represent their pronunciation.

steps.title: Summary
body: Pinyin represents the sounds of Chinese with the Latin alphabet.
Each syllable has an initial, a final, and a tone.
Tones distinguish meanings: mā, má, mǎ, and mà are different words.

steps.title: The Puzzle Pieces
body: Today we take apart the Chinese syllable. You will learn the groups of initials that are hardest for Spanish speakers and the essential finals.

steps.title: Easy and Difficult Initials
body: Many initials sound almost like in Spanish: b, p, m, f, d, t, n, l. Others require a new ear:
· zh, ch, sh, r: pronounced with the tongue curled back (retroflex). «zh» sounds like a soft «ch»; «r» resembles an English «r» with vibration.
· j, q, x: pronounced with a flat tongue and stretched lips. «x» is between «s» and «sh»; «q» is like «ch» but tenser.
· z, c, s: «z» sounds like «ds», «c» like «ts» (with a puff of air!).

steps.title: Essential Finals
body: The simple finals are a, o, e, i, u, ü. The Chinese «e» sounds between «e» and «o» (like «de» said lazily). The «ü» is like the French u: say «i» with the lips of «u».
Then come the compound ones: ai, ei, ao, ou, an, en, ang, eng, ong… The difference between -n and -ng is key: «an» ends with the tongue touching the teeth; «ang» resonates in the nose.

exercise.prompt: Which group of initials is pronounced with the tongue curled back?
exercise.explanation: zh, ch, sh, and r are the retroflexes: the tip of the tongue curves toward the palate.

options.label: Like an i with rounded u lips

exercise.explanation: ü is produced by saying «i» while the lips form a «u»: just like the French u.

steps.title: Summary
body: Retroflex initials: zh, ch, sh, r. Palatals: j, q, x. Sibilants: z, c, s.
ü is an i with rounded lips.
Distinguish -n (dental) from -ng (nasal).

steps.title: The Music of Chinese
body: Tones are the most famous — and most feared — part of Chinese. The good news: there are only four, plus a neutral one, and they follow completely regular patterns.

steps.title: The Five Patterns
body: First tone (ā): high and steady, like a held note. Think of a beep: «aaaa».
Second tone (á): rising, like when you ask «what?» in surprise.
Third tone (ǎ): falls then rises, like a thoughtful «mmm». In fast speech it often just falls.
Fourth tone (à): falling and sharp, like a command: «now!».
Neutral tone (a): brief and unstressed, leaning on the previous syllable.

steps.title: Tone Changes (Sandhi)
body: Two consecutive third tones: the first becomes second. «nǐ hǎo» is pronounced «ní hǎo».
不 (bù) becomes bú before another fourth tone: bú shì.
一 (yī) changes depending on what follows: yí before fourth tone (yí ge), yì before the others (yì bēi).

exercise.prompt: Listen to the syllable and choose the tone you hear.
exercise.subject: mā
exercise.explanation: mā (妈) takes the first tone: high and steady.

exercise.prompt: How is 你好 (nǐ hǎo) actually pronounced?

options.label: ní hǎo: the first changes to second tone

exercise.explanation: When two third tones come together, the first is pronounced as second: ní hǎo.

steps.title: Summary
body: 1st high and level · 2nd rising · 3rd fall-rise · 4th falling · neutral brief.
Two third tones: the first becomes second.
不 and 一 change tone depending on context.

steps.title: Your First Conversation
body: Today you speak your first real words in Chinese. By the end you will know how to greet, ask how someone is, and respond.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 你好！
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ!
dialogue.translation: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 你好！你好吗？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! nǐ hǎo ma?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ! ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ ㄇㄚ˙?
dialogue.translation: Hello! How are you?

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie. nǐ ne?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄏㄠˇ, ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙. ㄋㄧˇ ㄋㄜ˙?
dialogue.translation: I am very well, thanks. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 我也很好。再见！
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ yě hěn hǎo. zàijiàn!
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄏㄠˇ. ㄗㄞˋㄐㄧㄢˋ!
dialogue.translation: I am also well. Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 再见！
dialogue.pinyin: zàijiàn!
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋㄐㄧㄢˋ!
dialogue.translation: Goodbye!

steps.title: Writing: 你 and 好
body: Watch the stroke order animation and practice each character in the grid.

exercise.prompt: How do you respond to «你好吗？»?
exercise.explanation: «How are you?» is answered with your state: 我很好 (I am very well).

exercise.prompt: Order the words to say «I am very well».
exercise.explanation: Subject + 很 + adjective: 我很好.

steps.title: Summary
body: 你好 to greet; 你好吗 to ask how someone is.
Respond with 我很好 and return the question with 你呢.
再见 to say goodbye; 谢谢 to say thanks.

title: My Name Is…
subtitle: Introducing Yourself and Asking for Names

steps.title: What is Your Name?
body: Introducing yourself is the key to any conversation. Today you learn to say your name, nationality, and occupation.

dialogue.speaker: 老师
dialogue.hanzi: 你好！你叫什么名字？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ! ㄋㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙ ㄇㄧㄥˊㄗ˙?
dialogue.translation: Hello! What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 我叫 Ana。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ jiào Ana.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ Aㄋㄚ˙.
dialogue.translation: My name is Ana.

dialogue.speaker: 老师
dialogue.hanzi: 你是哪国人？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄕˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄖㄣˊ?
dialogue.translation: What country are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 我是西班牙人。我是学生。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ shì xībānyárén. wǒ shì xuésheng.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄅㄢㄧㄚˊㄖㄣˊ. ㄨㄛˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄕㄥ˙.
dialogue.translation: I am Spanish. I am a student.

exercise.explanation: 叫 = to be called; 什么名字 = what name.

exercise.prompt: Order to say «I am a student».
exercise.explanation: A + 是 + B: 我是学生.

steps.title: Summary
body: 我叫… for your name; 我是…人 for your nationality; 我是学生/老师 for your occupation.

steps.title: Chinese Politeness
body: Politeness in China works differently than in Spain: thanks are given less between close people (it would create distance), but formulas are essential with strangers.

steps.title: Responding to Thanks
body: To 谢谢 you reply 不客气 (bú kèqi, «you are welcome», literally «don't be polite») or 不用谢 (bú yòng xiè, «no need to thank»).
To 对不起 (sorry) you reply 没关系 (méi guānxi, «it doesn't matter»).

exercise.prompt: Someone says 谢谢 to you. What do you reply?
exercise.explanation: 不客气 is the natural response to thanks.

steps.title: Summary
body: 谢谢 → 不客气 · 对不起 → 没关系 · 请 softens any request.

title: Numbers 0 to 99
subtitle: The Most Logical System in the World

steps.title: A Perfect System
body: Chinese numbers are absolutely logical: learn ten words and you can count to 99. Eleven is «ten-one» (十一), twenty is «two-ten» (二十), and ninety-nine is «nine-ten-nine» (九十九).

steps.title: Building Numbers
body: Tens: unit + 十 → 二十 (20), 五十 (50).
Combined: 二十三 (23), 九十八 (98).
Note: for «two» before a classifier use 两 (liǎng), not 二: 两个人 (two people).

exercise.prompt: Listen to the number and choose the correct one.

steps.title: Summary
body: Ten words are enough to reach 99. 两 replaces 二 before classifiers.

steps.title: The Modern Chinese Calendar
body: Months and days of the week are also numbers: January is «month one» (一月), Monday is «week day one» (星期一). Only Sunday is special: 星期天.

steps.title: Full Dates
body: The order is always largest to smallest: year → month → day. 2026年7月18日 = July 18, 2026.
年 (nián) = year, 月 (yuè) = month, 日/号 (rì/hào) = day.
Days of the week: 星期一 (Monday) … 星期六 (Saturday), 星期天/星期日 (Sunday).

exercise.prompt: What date is 十月一日?
exercise.explanation: 十月 = month 10 (October), 一日 = day 1.

steps.title: Summary
body: Dates largest to smallest: 年 → 月 → 日. Days of the week with 星期 + number.

steps.title: At the Market
body: Asking prices is one of the first things you will use in China. The currency is the yuan (元), colloquially called 块 (kuài).

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 你好，这个多少钱？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, zhè ge duōshao qián?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ, ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄉㄨㄛㄕㄠ˙ ㄑㄧㄢˊ?
dialogue.translation: Hello, how much does this cost?

dialogue.speaker: 老板
dialogue.hanzi: 五块钱。
dialogue.pinyin: wǔ kuài qián.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ.
dialogue.translation: Five yuan.

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我买两个。
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ mǎi liǎng ge.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ, ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄞˇ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄍㄜ˙.
dialogue.translation: OK, I will take two.

dialogue.speaker: 老板
dialogue.hanzi: 十块。谢谢！
dialogue.pinyin: shí kuài. xièxie!
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄎㄨㄞˋ. ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙!
dialogue.translation: Ten yuan. Thanks!

exercise.prompt: How do you ask the price of something?
exercise.explanation: 多少钱 = how much money? It is the standard formula for asking prices.

steps.title: Summary
body: 多少钱 to ask prices; 块 is the colloquial word for yuan; remember 两 for «two» + classifier.

title: My Family
subtitle: Parents, Siblings, and the Particle 的

steps.title: The Chinese Family
body: Chinese distinguishes each family member precisely: an older brother (哥哥) is not the same as a younger brother (弟弟). Today we start with the core: parents and siblings.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 这是你的家吗？
dialogue.pinyin: zhè shì nǐ de jiā ma?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄇㄚ˙?
dialogue.translation: Is this your family?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 是。这是我爸爸，这是我妈妈。
dialogue.pinyin: shì. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄕˋ. ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄚˋㄅㄚ˙, ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄚㄇㄚ˙.
dialogue.translation: Yes. This is my father and this is my mother.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 你有哥哥吗？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ yǒu gēge ma?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄍㄜㄍㄜ˙ ㄇㄚ˙?
dialogue.translation: Do you have older brothers?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 没有，我有一个弟弟。
dialogue.pinyin: méiyǒu, wǒ yǒu yí ge dìdi.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄇㄟˊㄧㄡˇ, ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˋㄉㄧ˙.
dialogue.translation: No, I have a younger brother.

exercise.prompt: What is the most natural way to say «my mother»?
exercise.explanation: With family members, 的 is omitted: 我妈妈 is natural.

steps.title: Summary
body: 有/没有 for having; marks possession but is omitted with family.

steps.title: Work and Identity
body: Asking about work is a common way to start a conversation in China. Today you learn basic professions and how to say where someone works.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 你妈妈做什么工作？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ māma zuò shénme gōngzuò?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄇㄚㄇㄚ˙ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄥㄗㄨㄛˋ?
dialogue.translation: What does your mother do for work?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 她是医生，在医院工作。
dialogue.pinyin: tā shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄕˋ ㄧㄕㄥ, ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄩㄢˋ ㄍㄨㄥㄗㄨㄛˋ.
dialogue.translation: She is a doctor, she works in a hospital.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ ne?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄋㄜ˙?
dialogue.translation: And you?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 我是学生，我学汉语。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ shì xuésheng, wǒ xué hànyǔ.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄕㄥ˙, ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄢˋㄩˇ.
dialogue.translation: I am a student, I study Chinese.

exercise.explanation: 在 + place + verb: the action takes place in that location.

steps.title: Summary
body: 做什么工作 to ask about profession; 在 + place + 工作 to say where one works.

steps.title: A Piece That Spanish Does Not Have
body: In Chinese you don't say «three books» but «three 本 books». That middle word is the classifier, and today you master it.

exercise.explanation: 本 is the classifier for books: 三本书.

exercise.prompt: Order to say «I have two friends».

steps.title: Summary
body: Number + classifier + noun, always. 个 is the generic one; 本 for books; 杯 for cups.

steps.title: The Chinese Verb: No Conjugations
body: Good news: Chinese verbs do not conjugate. 我吃, 你吃, 他吃 — the verb never changes. Word order and particles do all the work.

exercise.prompt: Order to say «Tomorrow I go to school».
exercise.explanation: The time (明天) goes before the verb: 我明天去学校.
喝 = to drink, 茶 = tea.

steps.title: Summary
body: Verbs do not conjugate. The order is SVO and time goes before the verb.

steps.title: Describe Your Day
body: With what you already know plus negation with 不 and 没, today you will be able to describe a full day of your life.

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 你几点起床？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄑㄧˇㄔㄨㄤˊ?
dialogue.translation: What time do you get up?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.hanzi: 我七点起床。你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng. nǐ ne?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄑㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄑㄧˇㄔㄨㄤˊ. ㄋㄧˇ ㄋㄜ˙?
dialogue.translation: I get up at seven. And you?

dialogue.speaker: 李明
dialogue.hanzi: 我八点。我不喜欢早起。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ bā diǎn. wǒ bù xǐhuan zǎo qǐ.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄚ ㄉㄧㄢˇ. ㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄒㄧˇㄏㄨㄢ˙ ㄗㄠˇ ㄑㄧˇ.
dialogue.translation: At eight. I don't like waking up early.

exercise.prompt: «Yesterday I didn't go to school» is said as…
exercise.explanation: Past action not done: negated with 没.

steps.title: Summary
body: 不 negates present/habits; 没 negates the past. 几点 asks the time of an action.

steps.title: Looking Back
body: You have reached the end of the first stretch. This lesson reviews the essentials before the unit assessment. Treat it like a friendly exam.

exercise.prompt: How do you ask someone's name?

exercise.explanation: Adjective with 很, without 是.

exercise.prompt: Listen and choose what you hear.
Order to say «How much does this book cost?»

steps.title: Level Complete!
body: You know how to greet, introduce yourself, count, talk about your family, and describe your routine.
Next stop: the unit assessment and HSK level 2.

steps.title: Greetings in Taiwan
body: In Taiwan, people greet each other with 你好 (nǐ hǎo), just like in mainland China. But you will also hear the Taiwanese-friendly 呷飽未？(chia̍h-pá-buē, 'Have you eaten?') — though TOCFL tests standard Mandarin.
Taiwan uses Traditional Chinese characters and pronunciation that can differ subtly from mainland standards.

steps.title: Lesson Objectives
body: Greet and respond naturally in Taiwan Mandarin.
Introduce yourself with 我叫 and 我是…人.
Recognize common Taiwan-specific vocabulary: 捷運, 機車, 便利商店.
Use 謝謝 and 不好意思 appropriately.

steps.title: Taiwan Key Words
body: 捷運 (jiéyùn) — MRT / subway
機車 (jīchē) — scooter / motorcycle
便利商店 (biànlì shāngdiàn) — convenience store (Taiwan has the highest density in the world!)
不好意思 (bù hǎoyìsi) — excuse me / sorry (more common than 對不起 in Taiwan)
謝謝 (xièxie) — thank you

exercise.prompt: What does 捷運 mean in Taiwan?

steps.title: Summary
body: 你好 and 謝謝 are universal · 不好意思 = polite excuse me
Taiwan uses Traditional characters and some different vocabulary

steps.title: Taiwan's Famous Night Markets
body: Night markets (夜市 yèshì) are a cornerstone of Taiwanese culture. TOCFL Novice 1 includes basic food vocabulary — enough to order a snack and ask the price.

steps.title: Lesson Objectives
body: Name common Taiwan street foods: 珍珠奶茶, 滷肉飯, 臭豆腐, 牛肉麵.
Ask prices: 多少錢？
Order food: 我要一個…
Use numbers 1-100 in the context of pricing.

steps.title: Taiwan Night Market Foods
body: 珍珠奶茶 (zhēnzhū nǎichá) — bubble milk tea
滷肉飯 (lǔròufàn) — braised pork rice
臭豆腐 (chòudòufu) — stinky tofu
牛肉麵 (niúròumiàn) — beef noodle soup
蚵仔煎 (kézǎijiān) — oyster omelette
雞排 (jīpái) — fried chicken cutlet

exercise.prompt: How do you ask 'How much does this cost?' at a night market?

steps.title: Summary
body: 珍珠奶茶 = bubble tea · 滷肉飯 = braised pork rice · 臭豆腐 = stinky tofu
多少錢？= How much? · 我要一個… = I'd like one…

steps.title: Eating Out in Taiwan
body: Taiwanese people eat out frequently. From small noodle shops (麵館) to hot pot restaurants (火鍋店), knowing how to order, ask for the check, and compliment the food is essential for the TOCFL Novice 2 level.

steps.title: Lesson Objectives
body: Order dishes and drinks at a restaurant.
Use 我要, 請給我, and 我想要 appropriately.
Ask for the check: 買單 or 結帳.
Compliment the food: 很好吃, 很特別.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 你好，請問有菜單嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn yǒu càidān ma?
dialogue.translation: Hello, do you have a menu?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ， ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄘㄞˋ ㄉㄢ ㄇㄚ˙？

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.hanzi: 有的。這是我們的菜單。
dialogue.pinyin: yǒu de. zhè shì wǒmen de càidān.
dialogue.translation: Yes, here is our menu.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˇ ㄉㄜ˙。 ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄘㄞˋ ㄉㄢ。

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 我要一碗牛肉麵。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ yào yī wǎn niúròumiàn.
dialogue.translation: I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄧ ㄨㄢˇ ㄋㄧㄡˊ ㄖㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ。

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.hanzi: 好的。還要別的嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo de. hái yào bié de ma?
dialogue.translation: Sure. Anything else?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄜ˙。 ㄏㄞˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄇㄚ˙？

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 再來一杯珍珠奶茶。謝謝！
dialogue.pinyin: zài lái yī bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá. xièxie!
dialogue.translation: Also a bubble milk tea. Thanks!
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄧ ㄅㄟ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄨ ㄋㄞˇ ㄔㄚˊ。 ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝˋ！

exercise.prompt: How do you ask for the check in Taiwan?

steps.title: Summary
body: 我要 + dish · 請給我 + item · 買單 = check please
很好吃 = delicious · 還要別的嗎？= Anything else?

steps.title: Getting Around Taipei
body: Taipei's MRT (捷運) is clean, efficient, and tourist-friendly. TOCFL Novice 2 expects you to ask for directions, buy tickets, and understand station announcements.

steps.title: Lesson Objectives
body: Ask for and give basic directions: 請問…在哪裡？
Use location words: 前面, 對面, 旁邊, 附近.
Buy MRT tickets and name stations: 台北車站, 西門, 101/世貿.
Understand simple directions: 左轉, 右轉, 直走.

dialogue.speaker: 遊客
dialogue.hanzi: 不好意思，請問台北101怎麼去？
dialogue.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn Táiběi 101 zěnme qù?
dialogue.translation: Excuse me, how do I get to Taipei 101?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄧˋ ㄙ， ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄅㄟˇ 101 ㄗㄣˇ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄑㄩˋ？

dialogue.speaker: 路人
dialogue.hanzi: 你可以坐捷運到台北101/世貿站。
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn dào Táiběi 101 / Shìmào zhàn.
dialogue.translation: You can take the MRT to Taipei 101/World Trade Center station.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄩㄣˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄅㄟˇ 101/ ㄕˋ ㄇㄠˋ ㄓㄢˋ。

dialogue.speaker: 遊客
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝！出站後怎麼走？
dialogue.pinyin: xièxie! chū zhàn hòu zěnme zǒu?
dialogue.translation: Thanks! How do I walk after exiting the station?
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝˋ！ ㄔㄨ ㄓㄢˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄗㄣˇ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄗㄡˇ？

dialogue.speaker: 路人
dialogue.hanzi: 出站以後直走，然後左轉就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: chū zhàn yǐhòu zhí zǒu, ránhòu zuǒ zhuǎn jiù dào le.
dialogue.translation: After exiting, go straight, then turn left and you'll be there.
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄔㄨ ㄓㄢˋ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ㄓˊ ㄗㄡˇ， ㄖㄢˊ ㄏㄡˋ ㄗㄨㄛˇ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄜ˙。

steps.title: Summary
body: 請問…在哪裡？= Excuse me, where is…?
直走 = go straight · 左轉 = turn left · 右轉 = turn right
捷運站 = MRT station · 出口 = exit

paragraphs.hanzi: 樂觀並不等於忽視風險，而是相信問題可以被克服。
paragraphs.pinyin: lè guān bìng bù děng yú hū shì fēng xiǎn ， ér shì xiāng xìn wèn tí kě yǐ bèi kè fú 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄌㄜˋ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄥˇ ㄩˊ ㄏㄨ ㄕˋ ㄈㄥ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄤ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄅㄟˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄈㄨˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Being optimistic does not mean ignoring risks; it means believing that problems can be overcome.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bersikap optimis bukan berarti mengabaikan risiko; itu berarti percaya bahwa masalah bisa diatasi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這不是個人看法，而是已經確認的事實。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè bú shì gè rén kàn fǎ ， ér shì yǐ jīng què rèn de shì shí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄎㄢˋ ㄈㄚˇ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄥ ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄖㄣˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˋ ㄕˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This is not a personal opinion, but an already confirmed fact.
paragraphs.translation_id: Fakta membuktikan bahwa persiapan jauh-jauh hari lebih dapat diandalkan dibandingkan melakukan upaya di saat-saat terakhir.

paragraphs.hanzi: 面對困難，他沒有低頭，而是大膽提出了新的做法。
paragraphs.pinyin: miàn duì kùn nán ， tā méi yǒu dī tóu ， ér shì dà dǎn tí chū le xīn de zuò fǎ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄢˊ ， ㄊㄚ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄉㄧ ㄊㄡˊ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄉㄚˋ ㄉㄢˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄈㄚˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Faced with difficulties, he did not bow his head, but boldly put forward a new approach.
paragraphs.translation_id: Menghadapi kesulitan, dia tidak menundukkan kepalanya, tetapi dengan berani mengedepankan pendekatan baru.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他的決定並非出自個人利益，而是為了整個團隊。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā de jué dìng bìng fēi chū zì gè rén lì yì ， ér shì wèi le zhěng gè tuán duì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄈㄟ ㄔㄨ ㄗˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄌㄧˋ ㄧˋ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄓㄥˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄊㄨㄢˊ ㄉㄨㄟˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: His decision did not come from personal interest, but was for the whole team.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keputusannya bukan berasal dari kepentingan pribadi, melainkan untuk seluruh tim.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這部電影最動人的地方，不是結局，而是人物之間的理解。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng zuì dòng rén de dì fāng ， bú shì jié jú ， ér shì rén wù zhī jiān de lǐ jiě 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄧㄥˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄨㄥˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˋ ㄈㄤ ， ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄐㄩˊ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄨˋ ㄓ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The most moving part of this film is not the ending, but the understanding between the characters.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bagian yang paling mengharukan dari film ini bukanlah bagian akhirnya, melainkan ikatan yang terjalin di antara para tokohnya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 產品失敗的原因並不單一，而是由多個因素造成的。
paragraphs.pinyin: chǎn pǐn shī bài de yuán yīn bìng bù dān yī ， ér shì yóu duō gè yīn sù zào chéng de 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄢˇ ㄆㄧㄣˇ ㄕ ㄅㄞˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄩㄢˊ ㄧㄣ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄢ ㄧ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄍㄜˋ ㄧㄣ ㄙㄨˋ ㄗㄠˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The reason the product failed is not singular; it was caused by several factors.
paragraphs.translation_id: Alasan kegagalan produk tersebut tidak hanya satu; hal itu disebabkan oleh beberapa faktor.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 本期培訓共有三十名學員，其中一半來自基層單位。
dialogue.pinyin: běn qī péi xùn gòng yǒu sān shí míng xué yuán ， qí zhōng yí bàn lái zì jī céng dān wèi 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄣˇ ㄑㄧ ㄆㄟˊ ㄒㄩㄣˋ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄙㄢ ㄕˊ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄩㄢˊ ， ㄑㄧˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄧˊ ㄅㄢˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄉㄢ ㄨㄟˋ 。
dialogue.translation: This training programme has thirty trainees in total, half of whom come from grassroots organisations.
dialogue.translation_en: This training programme has thirty trainees in total, half of whom come from grassroots organisations.
dialogue.translation_id: Program pelatihan ini memiliki total tiga puluh peserta, setengahnya berasal dari organisasi akar rumput.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 她主動申請到基層崗位工作，希望更直接地瞭解群眾需求。
dialogue.pinyin: tā zhǔ dòng shēn qǐng dào jī céng gǎng wèi gōng zuò ， xī wàng gèng zhí jiē dì liǎo jiě qún zhòng xū qiú 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄓㄨˇ ㄉㄨㄥˋ ㄕㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄍㄤˇ ㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ， ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄍㄥˋ ㄓˊ ㄐㄧㄝ ㄉㄧˋ ㄌㄧㄠˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄑㄩㄣˊ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄒㄩ ㄑㄧㄡˊ 。
dialogue.translation: She took the initiative to apply for a grassroots post, hoping to understand people’s needs more directly.
dialogue.translation_en: She took the initiative to apply for a grassroots post, hoping to understand people’s needs more directly.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia mengambil inisiatif untuk melamar posisi akar rumput, dengan harapan dapat memahami kebutuhan masyarakat secara lebih langsung.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 他寧願待在基層積累經驗，也不急著爭取管理職位。
dialogue.pinyin: tā níng yuàn dài zài jī céng jī lèi jīng yàn ， yě bù jí zhù zhēng qǔ guǎn lǐ zhí wèi 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄋㄧㄥˊ ㄩㄢˋ ㄉㄞˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄐㄧ ㄌㄟˋ ㄐㄧㄥ ㄧㄢˋ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧˊ ㄓㄨˋ ㄓㄥ ㄑㄩˇ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄓˊ ㄨㄟˋ 。
dialogue.translation: He would rather stay at the grass-roots level to gain experience than rush to seek a management position.
dialogue.translation_en: He would rather stay at the grass-roots level to gain experience than rush to seek a management position.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia lebih suka bertahan di tingkat akar rumput untuk mendapatkan pengalaman daripada terburu-buru mencari posisi manajemen.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 對管理者來說，傾聽基層意見不是可選項，而是一門必修課。
dialogue.pinyin: duì guǎn lǐ zhě lái shuō ， qīng tīng jī céng yì jiàn bú shì kě xuǎn xiàng ， ér shì yī mén bì xiū kè 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄓㄜˇ ㄌㄞˊ ㄕㄨㄛ ， ㄑㄧㄥ ㄊㄧㄥ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄒㄩㄢˇ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄧ ㄇㄣˊ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄧㄡ ㄎㄜˋ 。
dialogue.translation: For managers, listening to grassroots opinions is not optional, but a compulsory lesson.
dialogue.translation_en: For managers, listening to grassroots opinions is not optional, but a compulsory lesson.
dialogue.translation_id: Bagi para manajer, mendengarkan pendapat masyarakat akar rumput bukanlah sebuah pilihan, namun sebuah pelajaran wajib.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 這份樸素的報告恰恰反映了基層工作的真實情況。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè fèn pǔ sù de bào gào qià qià fǎn yìng le jī céng gōng zuò de zhēn shí qíng kuàng 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄆㄨˇ ㄙㄨˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄑㄧㄚˋ ㄑㄧㄚˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄧㄥˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄣ ㄕˊ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄎㄨㄤˋ 。
dialogue.translation: This plain report is precisely what reflects the real situation of grassroots work.
dialogue.translation_en: This plain report is precisely what reflects the real situation of grassroots work.
dialogue.translation_id: Laporan sederhana ini justru mencerminkan keadaan sebenarnya dari kegiatan di tingkat akar rumput.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 他大學畢業後進入一家地方報社，從基層記者做起。
dialogue.pinyin: tā dà xué bì yè hòu jìn rù yī jiā dì fāng bào shè ， cóng jī céng jì zhě zuò qǐ 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄚˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄅㄧˋ ㄧㄝˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄖㄨˋ ㄧ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄉㄧˋ ㄈㄤ ㄅㄠˋ ㄕㄜˋ ， ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄐㄧ ㄘㄥˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄓㄜˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄑㄧˇ 。
dialogue.translation: After graduating from university, he joined a local newspaper office and started as a junior reporter.
dialogue.translation_en: After graduating from university, he joined a local newspaper office and started as a junior reporter.
dialogue.translation_id: Setelah lulus dari universitas, ia bergabung dengan redaksi surat kabar lokal dan memulai kariernya sebagai reporter pemula.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about rather.

paragraphs.hanzi: 數據顯示，本季度銷售額比去年同期上漲了百分之十。
paragraphs.pinyin: shù jù xiǎn shì ， běn jì dù xiāo shòu é bǐ qù nián tóng qī shàng zhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ㄕˋ ， ㄅㄣˇ ㄐㄧˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄒㄧㄠ ㄕㄡˋ ㄜˊ ㄅㄧˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄑㄧ ㄕㄤˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄅㄞˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓ ㄕˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The data shows that this quarter’s sales rose by ten percent compared with the same period last year.
paragraphs.translation_id: Data menunjukkan penjualan kuartal ini naik sepuluh persen dibandingkan periode yang sama tahun lalu.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這份報告的數據不足，暫時不能作為最終依據。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào de shù jù bù zú ， zàn shí bù néng zuò wèi zuì zhōng yī jù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄗㄨˊ ， ㄗㄢˋ ㄕˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄧ ㄐㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The data in this report is insufficient, so it cannot be used as the final basis for now.
paragraphs.translation_id: Data dalam laporan ini tidak mencukupi, sehingga tidak dapat digunakan sebagai dasar akhir untuk saat ini.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這個評價太主觀，缺少實際數據。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè gè píng jià tài zhǔ guān ， quē shǎo shí jì shù jù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄓㄨˇ ㄍㄨㄢ ， ㄑㄩㄝ ㄕㄠˇ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This evaluation is too subjective and lacks real data.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pernyataannya jelas bernada subyektif.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這份報告包括數據以及專家意見。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào bāo kuò shù jù yǐ jí zhuān jiā yì jiàn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄠ ㄎㄨㄛˋ ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ㄧˇ ㄐㄧˊ ㄓㄨㄢ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This report includes data as well as expert opinions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Laporan ini mencakup data serta pendapat para ahli.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這份報告的價值不在於數據多少，而在於分析是否準確。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào de jià zhí bù zài yú shù jù duō shǎo ， ér zài yú fēn xī shì fǒu zhǔn què 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄓˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄩˊ ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄕㄠˇ ， ㄦˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄩˊ ㄈㄣ ㄒㄧ ㄕˋ ㄈㄡˇ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄑㄩㄝˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The value of this report does not lie in how much data it has, but in whether the analysis is accurate.
paragraphs.translation_id: Nilai laporan ini tidak terletak pada seberapa banyak data yang dimilikinya, namun pada keakuratan analisisnya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果發現數據有誤，請及時修改系統記錄。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ fā xiàn shù jù yǒu wù ， qǐng jí shí xiū gǎi xì tǒng jì lù 。

paragraphs.hanzi: 假如你只看表面現象，很容易忽視真正的問題。

paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄚˇ ㄖㄨˊ ㄋㄧˇ ㄓˇ ㄎㄢˋ ㄅㄧㄠˇ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ， ㄏㄣˇ ㄖㄨㄥˊ ㄧˋ ㄏㄨ ㄕˋ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: If you only look at surface phenomena, it is easy to ignore the real problem.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika Anda hanya melihat fenomena permukaan saja, maka mudah untuk mengabaikan masalah sebenarnya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 沒有親身經歷過，可能很難真正同情別人的痛苦。
paragraphs.pinyin: méi yǒu qīn shēn jīng lì guò ， kě néng hěn nán zhēn zhèng tóng qíng bié rén de tòng kǔ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄑㄧㄣ ㄕㄣ ㄐㄧㄥ ㄌㄧˋ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ， ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄊㄨㄥˋ ㄎㄨˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Without having experienced it personally, it may be hard to truly sympathise with another person’s pain.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tanpa mengalaminya sendiri, mungkin sulit untuk benar-benar merasakan penderitaan orang lain.

paragraphs.hanzi: 真正善良的人不會為了表現自己而幫助別人。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng shàn liáng de rén bù huì wèi le biǎo xiàn zì jǐ ér bāng zhù bié rén 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄕㄢˋ ㄌㄧㄤˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄅㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄦˊ ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Truly kind people do not help others just to show themselves off.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang yang benar-benar baik hati tidak membantu orang lain hanya untuk pamer.

paragraphs.hanzi: 真正富的人不一定只關心錢。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng fù de rén bù yí dìng zhǐ guān xīn qián 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄓˇ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄑㄧㄢˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: People who are truly rich do not necessarily care only about money.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang-orang yang benar-benar kaya tidak selalu hanya mementingkan uang.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果不承認差距，就很難找到真正的改進方向。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ bù chéng rèn chā jù ， jiù hěn nán zhǎo dào zhēn zhèng de gǎi jìn fāng xiàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄖㄣˋ ㄔㄚ ㄐㄩˋ ， ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄓㄠˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄍㄞˇ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄈㄤ ㄒㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: If we do not acknowledge the gap, it is hard to find the real direction for improvement.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika kita tidak mengakui kesenjangan tersebut, sulit menemukan arah perbaikan yang nyata.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我們需要了解這個詞的真正意義。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào liǎo jiě zhè gè cí de zhēn zhèng yì yì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄠˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄘˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄧˋ ㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: We need to understand the true meaning of this word.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kita perlu memahami makna sebenarnya dari kata ini.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 我們不只是同情失業的人，還應該提供實際幫助。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ men bù zhǐ shì tóng qíng shī yè de rén ， hái yīng gāi tí gōng shí jì bāng zhù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄕ ㄧㄝˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄧㄥ ㄍㄞ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ 。
dialogue.translation: We should not only sympathise with people who are unemployed, but also provide practical help.
dialogue.translation_en: We should not only sympathise with people who are unemployed, but also provide practical help.
dialogue.translation_id: Kita tidak hanya harus bersimpati kepada orang-orang yang menganggur, tetapi juga memberikan bantuan yang nyata.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 老師沒有否定他的努力，只是指出了方法上的問題。
dialogue.pinyin: lǎo shī méi yǒu fǒu dìng tā de nǔ lì ， zhǐ shì zhǐ chū le fāng fǎ shàng de wèn tí 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄡˇ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄋㄨˇ ㄌㄧˋ ， ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄓˇ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄈㄤ ㄈㄚˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ 。
dialogue.translation: The teacher did not dismiss his effort, but only pointed out problems with the method.
dialogue.translation_en: The teacher did not dismiss his effort, but only pointed out problems with the method.
dialogue.translation_id: Guru tersebut tidak meremehkan usahanya, melainkan hanya menyoroti beberapa masalah dalam metode yang digunakannya.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 他能通過考試不只是因為好運，更因為準備充分。
dialogue.pinyin: tā néng tōng guò kǎo shì bù zhǐ shì yīn wèi hǎo yùn ， gèng yīn wèi zhǔn bèi chōng fèn 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄋㄥˊ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄎㄠˇ ㄕˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄣ ㄨㄟˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄩㄣˋ ， ㄍㄥˋ ㄧㄣ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄅㄟˋ ㄔㄨㄥ ㄈㄣˋ 。
dialogue.translation: He passed the exam not only because of good luck, but even more because he was well prepared.
dialogue.translation_en: He passed the exam not only because of good luck, but even more because he was well prepared.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia lulus ujian bukan hanya karena keberuntungan, tetapi lebih karena dia telah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子參與家務，不只是幫忙，也是學習責任。
dialogue.pinyin: hái zi cān yǔ jiā wù ， bù zhǐ shì bāng máng ， yě shì xué xí zé rèn 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄘㄢ ㄩˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄨˋ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄅㄤ ㄇㄤˊ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧˊ ㄗㄜˊ ㄖㄣˋ 。
dialogue.translation: When children take part in household chores, they are not only helping but also learning responsibility.
dialogue.translation_en: When children take part in household chores, they are not only helping but also learning responsibility.
dialogue.translation_id: Ketika anak-anak mengambil bagian dalam pekerjaan rumah tangga, mereka tidak hanya membantu tetapi juga belajar tanggung jawab.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 這次成功不只是幸運，更是長期努力的結果。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè cì chéng gōng bù zhǐ shì xìng yùn ， gèng shì zhǎng qī nǔ lì de jié guǒ 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄩㄣˋ ， ㄍㄥˋ ㄕˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄑㄧ ㄋㄨˇ ㄌㄧˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ 。
dialogue.translation: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_en: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_id: Kesuksesan ini bukan sekedar keberuntungan, namun lebih merupakan hasil usaha jangka panjang.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 別把我的提醒當成批評，我只是想幫你避免錯誤。
dialogue.pinyin: bié bǎ wǒ de tí xǐng dāng chéng pī píng ， wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng bāng nǐ bì miǎn cuò wù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄤ ㄔㄥˊ ㄆㄧ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄅㄤ ㄋㄧˇ ㄅㄧˋ ㄇㄧㄢˇ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄨˋ 。
dialogue.translation: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_en: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_id: Jangan menganggap pengingat saya sebagai kritik; Saya hanya ingin membantu Anda menghindari kesalahan.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about genuine; real; true; really; indeed.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在他最困難的時候，親情給了他重新開始的力量。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài tā zuì kùn nán de shí hòu ， qīn qíng gěi le tā chóng xīn kāi shǐ de lì liàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄊㄚ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄢˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄑㄧㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄍㄟˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: At his most difficult time, family affection gave him the strength to start again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di saat tersulitnya, kasih sayang keluarga memberinya kekuatan untuk memulai kembali.

paragraphs.hanzi: 合同到期以後，雙方可以重新商量待遇。
paragraphs.pinyin: hé tóng dào qī yǐ hòu ， shuāng fāng kě yǐ chóng xīn shāng liáng dài yù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄑㄧ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄕㄨㄤ ㄈㄤ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄕㄤ ㄌㄧㄤˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: After the contract expires, both sides can discuss the terms again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah kontrak berakhir, kedua belah pihak dapat mendiskusikan kembali persyaratannya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 最近原材料價格變動很大，公司不得不重新計算成本。
paragraphs.pinyin: zuì jìn yuán cái liào jià gé biàn dòng hěn dà ， gōng sī bù dé bù chóng xīn jì suàn chéng běn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄍㄜˊ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄥˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄚˋ ， ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄐㄧˋ ㄙㄨㄢˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Recently, raw material prices have fluctuated greatly, so the company has had to recalculate costs.
paragraphs.translation_id: Belakangan ini, harga bahan baku mengalami fluktuasi yang cukup besar, sehingga perusahaan terpaksa menghitung ulang biayanya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 為了適應當地口味，品牌重新設計了菜單。
paragraphs.pinyin: wèi le shì yīng dāng dì kǒu wèi ， pǐn pái chóng xīn shè jì le cài dān 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄕˋ ㄧㄥ ㄉㄤ ㄉㄧˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄨㄟˋ ， ㄆㄧㄣˇ ㄆㄞˊ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄕㄜˋ ㄐㄧˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄘㄞˋ ㄉㄢ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: To suit local tastes, the brand redesigned its menu.
paragraphs.translation_id: Untuk menyesuaikan dengan selera lokal, merek tersebut merancang ulang menunya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他決定告別過去的生活，去一個新的城市重新開始。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā jué dìng gào bié guò qù de shēng huó ， qù yī gè xīn de chéng shì chóng xīn kāi shǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ， ㄑㄩˋ ㄧ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He decided to say goodbye to his past life and make a fresh start in a new city.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia memutuskan untuk melepaskan diri dari kehidupan lamanya dan memulai hidup baru di kota yang baru.

paragraphs.hanzi: 她忘了帶身份證，所以護士讓她重新掛號。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā wàng le dài shēn fèn zhèng ， suǒ yǐ hù shì ràng tā chóng xīn guà hào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄨㄤˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄉㄞˋ ㄕㄣ ㄈㄣˋ ㄓㄥˋ ， ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄕˋ ㄖㄤˋ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄍㄨㄚˋ ㄏㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: She forgot to bring her ID card, so the nurse asked her to register again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia lupa membawa kartu identitasnya, jadi perawat itu memintanya untuk mendaftar ulang.

dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄩㄣˋ ， ㄍㄥˋ ㄕˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄑㄧ ㄋㄨˇ ㄌㄧˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ 。
dialogue.translation: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_en: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_id: Kesuksesan ini bukan sekedar keberuntungan, namun lebih merupakan hasil usaha jangka panjang.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 別把我的提醒當成批評，我只是想幫你避免錯誤。
dialogue.pinyin: bié bǎ wǒ de tí xǐng dāng chéng pī píng ， wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng bāng nǐ bì miǎn cuò wù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄤ ㄔㄥˊ ㄆㄧ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄅㄤ ㄋㄧˇ ㄅㄧˋ ㄇㄧㄢˇ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄨˋ 。
dialogue.translation: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_en: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_id: Jangan menganggap pengingat saya sebagai kritik; Saya hanya ingin membantu Anda menghindari kesalahan.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about again; once more; re-.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這件衣服顏色不醜，只是不太適合正式場合。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú yán sè bù chǒu ， zhǐ shì bù tài shì hé zhèng shì chǎng hé 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄧ ㄈㄨˊ ㄧㄢˊ ㄙㄜˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄔㄡˇ ， ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄕˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄓㄥˋ ㄕˋ ㄔㄤˇ ㄏㄜˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The colour of this item of clothing is not ugly; it is just not very suitable for formal occasions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jangan mengolok-olok orang lain hanya karena penampilannya jelek;

paragraphs.hanzi: 這種情況只是個別現象，不能代表整體水平。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng zhǐ shì gè bié xiàn xiàng ， bù néng dài biǎo zhěng tǐ shuǐ píng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄓㄨㄥˇ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄎㄨㄤˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄋㄥˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄅㄧㄠˇ ㄓㄥˇ ㄊㄧˇ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄆㄧㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This situation is only an isolated phenomenon and cannot represent the overall level.
paragraphs.translation_id: Situasi ini hanyalah fenomena yang terisolasi dan tidak dapat mewakili tingkat keseluruhan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 學生應該主動思考問題，而不只是等答案。
paragraphs.pinyin: xué shēng yīng gāi zhǔ dòng sī kǎo wèn tí ， ér bù zhǐ shì děng dá àn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄕㄥ ㄧㄥ ㄍㄞ ㄓㄨˇ ㄉㄨㄥˋ ㄙ ㄎㄠˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ， ㄦˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄉㄥˇ ㄉㄚˊ ㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Students should think about problems proactively, not just wait for answers.
paragraphs.translation_id: Siswa hendaknya memikirkan masalah secara proaktif, tidak hanya menunggu jawaban.

paragraphs.hanzi: 醫生說這只是輕傷，不會影響正常生活。
paragraphs.pinyin: yī shēng shuō zhè zhǐ shì qīng shāng ， bù huì yǐng xiǎng zhèng cháng shēng huó 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄧ ㄕㄥ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄓㄜˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄕㄤ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄥˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄓㄥˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The doctor said this was only a minor injury and would not affect normal life.
paragraphs.translation_id: untuk melukai

paragraphs.hanzi: 教育兒女不只是學校的責任，也是家庭的責任。
paragraphs.pinyin: jiào yù ér nǚ bù zhǐ shì xué xiào de zé rèn ， yě shì jiā tíng de zé rèn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄩˋ ㄦˊ ㄋㄩˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗㄜˊ ㄖㄣˋ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄕˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄊㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗㄜˊ ㄖㄣˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Educating children is not only the school’s responsibility, but also the family’s responsibility.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mendidik anak bukan hanya tanggung jawab sekolah, tapi juga tanggung jawab keluarga.

paragraphs.hanzi: 創業不只是有一個好想法，還需要穩定的資金和團隊。
paragraphs.pinyin: chuàng yè bù zhǐ shì yǒu yī gè hǎo xiǎng fǎ ， hái xū yào wěn dìng de zī jīn hé tuán duì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄨㄤˋ ㄧㄝˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄧ ㄍㄜˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄈㄚˇ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄨㄣˇ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄢˊ ㄉㄨㄟˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Starting a business is not just about having a good idea; it also requires stable funding and a team.
paragraphs.translation_id: Memulai bisnis bukan hanya soal memiliki ide bagus; itu juga membutuhkan pendanaan dan tim yang stabil.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 我們不只是同情失業的人，還應該提供實際幫助。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ men bù zhǐ shì tóng qíng shī yè de rén ， hái yīng gāi tí gōng shí jì bāng zhù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄕ ㄧㄝˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄧㄥ ㄍㄞ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ 。
dialogue.translation: We should not only sympathise with people who are unemployed, but also provide practical help.
dialogue.translation_en: We should not only sympathise with people who are unemployed, but also provide practical help.
dialogue.translation_id: Kita tidak hanya harus bersimpati kepada orang-orang yang menganggur, tetapi juga memberikan bantuan yang nyata.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 老師沒有否定他的努力，只是指出了方法上的問題。
dialogue.pinyin: lǎo shī méi yǒu fǒu dìng tā de nǔ lì ， zhǐ shì zhǐ chū le fāng fǎ shàng de wèn tí 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄡˇ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄋㄨˇ ㄌㄧˋ ， ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄓˇ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄈㄤ ㄈㄚˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ 。
dialogue.translation: The teacher did not dismiss his effort, but only pointed out problems with the method.
dialogue.translation_en: The teacher did not dismiss his effort, but only pointed out problems with the method.
dialogue.translation_id: Guru tersebut tidak meremehkan usahanya, melainkan hanya menyoroti beberapa masalah dalam metode yang digunakannya.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 他能通過考試不只是因為好運，更因為準備充分。
dialogue.pinyin: tā néng tōng guò kǎo shì bù zhǐ shì yīn wèi hǎo yùn ， gèng yīn wèi zhǔn bèi chōng fèn 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄋㄥˊ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄎㄠˇ ㄕˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄣ ㄨㄟˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄩㄣˋ ， ㄍㄥˋ ㄧㄣ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄅㄟˋ ㄔㄨㄥ ㄈㄣˋ 。
dialogue.translation: He passed the exam not only because of good luck, but even more because he was well prepared.
dialogue.translation_en: He passed the exam not only because of good luck, but even more because he was well prepared.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia lulus ujian bukan hanya karena keberuntungan, tetapi lebih karena dia telah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子參與家務，不只是幫忙，也是學習責任。
dialogue.pinyin: hái zi cān yǔ jiā wù ， bù zhǐ shì bāng máng ， yě shì xué xí zé rèn 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄘㄢ ㄩˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄨˋ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄅㄤ ㄇㄤˊ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧˊ ㄗㄜˊ ㄖㄣˋ 。
dialogue.translation: When children take part in household chores, they are not only helping but also learning responsibility.
dialogue.translation_en: When children take part in household chores, they are not only helping but also learning responsibility.
dialogue.translation_id: Ketika anak-anak mengambil bagian dalam pekerjaan rumah tangga, mereka tidak hanya membantu tetapi juga belajar tanggung jawab.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 這次成功不只是幸運，更是長期努力的結果。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè cì chéng gōng bù zhǐ shì xìng yùn ， gèng shì zhǎng qī nǔ lì de jié guǒ 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄩㄣˋ ， ㄍㄥˋ ㄕˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄑㄧ ㄋㄨˇ ㄌㄧˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ 。
dialogue.translation: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_en: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.
dialogue.translation_id: Kesuksesan ini bukan sekedar keberuntungan, namun lebih merupakan hasil usaha jangka panjang.

dialogue.hanzi: 別把我的提醒當成批評，我只是想幫你避免錯誤。
dialogue.pinyin: bié bǎ wǒ de tí xǐng dāng chéng pī píng ， wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng bāng nǐ bì miǎn cuò wù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄤ ㄔㄥˊ ㄆㄧ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄅㄤ ㄋㄧˇ ㄅㄧˋ ㄇㄧㄢˇ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄨˋ 。
dialogue.translation: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_en: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.
dialogue.translation_id: Jangan menganggap pengingat saya sebagai kritik; Saya hanya ingin membantu Anda menghindari kesalahan.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about merely; only; just; nothing but; simply; but; however.

paragraphs.hanzi: 無論結果如何，比賽的過程必須公平。
paragraphs.pinyin: wú lùn jié guǒ rú hé ， bǐ sài de guò chéng bì xū gōng píng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨˊ ㄌㄨㄣˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄖㄨˊ ㄏㄜˊ ， ㄅㄧˇ ㄙㄞˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄆㄧㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: No matter what the result is, the process of the competition must be fair.
paragraphs.translation_id: Apapun hasilnya, proses persaingan harus adil.

paragraphs.hanzi: 時間很緊，我們必須先處理最重要的部分。
paragraphs.pinyin: shí jiān hěn jǐn ， wǒ men bì xū xiān chù lǐ zuì zhòng yào de bù fèn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄏㄣˇ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄔㄨˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄈㄣˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Time is tight, so we must deal with the most important part first.
paragraphs.translation_id: Waktu sangat terbatas, jadi kita harus menangani bagian yang paling penting terlebih dahulu.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這個路口行人很多，司機必須減速。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè gè lù kǒu xíng rén hěn duō ， sī jī bì xū jiǎn sù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ， ㄙ ㄐㄧ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄙㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: There are many pedestrians at this junction, so drivers must slow down.
paragraphs.translation_id: Banyak pejalan kaki di persimpangan ini, sehingga pengemudi harus memperlambat kecepatan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 處理緊急事務時，必須先分清事情的輕重。
paragraphs.pinyin: chù lǐ jǐn jí shì wù shí ， bì xū xiān fēn qīng shì qíng de qīng zhòng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄨˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄐㄧˊ ㄕˋ ㄨˋ ㄕˊ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄈㄣ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄕˋ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄓㄨㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: When handling urgent matters, one must first distinguish their relative importance.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saat menangani hal-hal yang mendesak, seseorang harus terlebih dahulu membedakan tingkat kepentingannya masing-masing.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在籤合同之前，我們必須先計算總成本和可能的風險。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài qiān hé tóng zhī qián ， wǒ men bì xū xiān jì suàn zǒng chéng běn hé kě néng de fēng xiǎn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄓ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄐㄧˋ ㄙㄨㄢˋ ㄗㄨㄥˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄈㄥ ㄒㄧㄢˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Before signing the contract, we must first calculate the total cost and possible risks.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sebelum menandatangani kontrak, kita harus menghitung dulu total biaya dan risiko yang mungkin terjadi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 網上辦事越來越便捷，但個人信息保護必須同步加強。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǎng shàng bàn shì yuè lái yuè biàn jié ， dàn gè rén xìn xī bǎo hù bì xū tóng bù jiā qiáng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄤˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄅㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄩㄝˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄩㄝˋ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ， ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄒㄧ ㄅㄠˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄑㄧㄤˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Handling administrative tasks online is becoming more convenient, but the protection of personal information must be strengthened at the same time.
paragraphs.translation_id: Menangani tugas-tugas administratif secara online menjadi lebih mudah, namun perlindungan informasi pribadi harus diperkuat pada saat yang bersamaan.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 這份報告不僅指出風險，也提出了許多正面的建議。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào bù jǐn zhǐ chū fēng xiǎn ， yě tí chū le xǔ duō zhèng miàn de jiàn yì 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄓˇ ㄔㄨ ㄈㄥ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄩˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄓㄥˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄧˋ 。
dialogue.translation: This report not only points out risks but also offers many positive suggestions.
dialogue.translation_en: This report not only points out risks but also offers many positive suggestions.
dialogue.translation_id: Laporan ini tidak hanya menunjukkan risiko tetapi juga memberikan banyak saran positif.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 他居然能在如此短的時間內完成報告，真了不起。
dialogue.pinyin: tā jū rán néng zài rú cǐ duǎn de shí jiān nèi wán chéng bào gào ， zhēn liǎo bù qǐ 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩ ㄖㄢˊ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄖㄨˊ ㄘˇ ㄉㄨㄢˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄋㄟˋ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄓㄣ ㄌㄧㄠˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄧˇ 。
dialogue.translation: He unexpectedly managed to finish the report in such a short time; that is really amazing.
dialogue.translation_en: He unexpectedly managed to finish the report in such a short time; that is really amazing.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia secara tak terduga berhasil menyelesaikan laporannya dalam waktu sesingkat itu; itu sungguh menakjubkan.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 會議結束前，每個部門都要報告本週的工作進展。

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about safe / safety.

paragraphs.hanzi: 李小姐提交的報告寫得非常清楚。
paragraphs.pinyin: lǐ xiǎo jiě tí jiāo de bào gào xiě dé fēi cháng qīng chǔ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄌㄧˇ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ㄉㄜˊ ㄈㄟ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄔㄨˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Miss Li’s submitted report was written very clearly.
paragraphs.translation_id: Laporan yang disampaikan Nona Li ditulis dengan sangat jelas.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他第一次嘗試用中文做報告，緊張得說錯了幾個詞。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā dì yī cì cháng shì yòng zhōng wén zuò bào gào ， jǐn zhāng dé shuō cuò le jǐ gè cí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ㄘˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄕˋ ㄩㄥˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄨㄣˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄓㄤ ㄉㄜˊ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄘˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He tried giving a report in Chinese for the first time and was so nervous that he said a few words wrong.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia mencoba memberikan laporan dalam bahasa Mandarin untuk pertama kalinya dan sangat gugup sehingga dia salah mengucapkan beberapa kata.

paragraphs.hanzi: 時間不多了，我們得抓緊完成報告。
paragraphs.pinyin: shí jiān bù duō le ， wǒ men dé zhuā jǐn wán chéng bào gào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄜ˙ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄜˊ ㄓㄨㄚ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: There is not much time left; we must hurry to finish the report.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tidak banyak waktu tersisa; kita harus bergegas menyelesaikan laporannya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他為了完成報告，整整工作了一個晚上。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā wèi le wán chéng bào gào ， zhěng zhěng gōng zuò le yī gè wǎn shàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄓㄥˇ ㄓㄥˇ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄧ ㄍㄜˋ ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: To finish the report, he worked for a whole night.
paragraphs.translation_id: Untuk menyelesaikan laporannya, dia bekerja sepanjang malam.

paragraphs.hanzi: 這份報告內容太雜，讀者很難抓住要點。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào nèi róng tài zá ， dú zhě hěn nán zhuā zhù yào diǎn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄋㄟˋ ㄖㄨㄥˊ ㄊㄞˋ ㄗㄚˊ ， ㄉㄨˊ ㄓㄜˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄓㄨㄚ ㄓㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The content of this report is too mixed, so readers find it hard to grasp the main points.
paragraphs.translation_id: Isi laporan ini terlalu campur aduk, sehingga pembaca sulit memahami poin utamanya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他提前整理資料，從而在報告會上回答得更有把握。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā tí qián zhěng lǐ zī liào ， cóng ér zài bào gào huì shàng huí dá dé gèng yǒu bǎ wò 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄊㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄓㄥˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ， ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄦˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄉㄚˊ ㄉㄜˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He organised the materials in advance, thereby answering with more confidence at the report meeting.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perusahaan menyesuaikan proses purna jualnya sehingga mengurangi keluhan pelanggan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 你最好提前出門，不然可能趕不上火車。

paragraphs.pinyin: wén jiàn tài dà ， shàng chuán guò chéng kě néng xū yào jǐ fēn zhōng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄣˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄉㄚˋ ， ㄕㄤˋ ㄔㄨㄢˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ 。

paragraphs.translation_id: Silakan pindai kontrak yang ditandatangani dan unggah ke sistem.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我最近不太閒，可能要下週才能見面。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ zuì jìn bù tài xián ， kě néng yào xià zhōu cái néng jiàn miàn 。

paragraphs.translation_id: Akhir-akhir ini aku tidak punya banyak waktu luang, jadi aku mungkin baru bisa bertemu minggu depan.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子們為了誰先玩玩具爭了起來。

dialogue.translation_en: The children started arguing over who could play with the toy first.
dialogue.translation_id: Dua perusahaan bersaing untuk proyek yang sama.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 雨後花園裡出現了很多蟲子，孩子們卻覺得很有趣。
dialogue.pinyin: yǔ hòu huā yuán lǐ chū xiàn le hěn duō chóng zi ， hái zi men què jué dé hěn yǒu qù 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄩˇ ㄏㄡˋ ㄏㄨㄚ ㄩㄢˊ ㄌㄧˇ ㄔㄨ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄗ˙ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄜˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄑㄩˋ 。

dialogue.translation_id: Setelah hujan, banyak serangga muncul di taman, tetapi anak-anak menganggapnya sangat menarik.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子們一聽到下課鈴，就像風似的跑出教室。

dialogue.translation: As soon as the children heard the class bell, they ran out of the classroom like the wind.
dialogue.translation_en: As soon as the children heard the class bell, they ran out of the classroom like the wind.
dialogue.translation_id: Begitu anak-anak mendengar bel kelas, mereka berlari keluar kelas seperti angin.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子用剪刀做手工時，老師一直在旁邊看著。
dialogue.pinyin: hái zi yòng jiǎn dāo zuò shǒu gōng shí ， lǎo shī yì zhí zài páng biān kàn zhù 。

dialogue.translation: When the children used scissors to do handicrafts, the teacher watched beside them the whole time.
dialogue.translation_en: When the children used scissors to do handicrafts, the teacher watched beside them the whole time.
dialogue.translation_id: Saat anak-anak menggunakan gunting untuk membuat kerajinan tangan, guru itu terus mengawasi mereka dari samping.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 支教老師在山區小學工作了三年，幫助很多孩子走出大山。
dialogue.pinyin: zhī jiào lǎo shī zài shān qū xiǎo xué gōng zuò le sān nián ， bāng zhù hěn duō hái zi zǒu chū dà shān 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄗㄞˋ ㄕㄢ ㄑㄩ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄙㄢ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ， ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄗㄡˇ ㄔㄨ ㄉㄚˋ ㄕㄢ 。
dialogue.translation: The volunteer teacher worked for three years at a primary school in the mountain area, helping many children leave the mountains.
dialogue.translation_en: The volunteer teacher worked for three years at a primary school in the mountain area, helping many children leave the mountains.
dialogue.translation_id: Guru sukarelawan tersebut bekerja selama tiga tahun di sebuah sekolah dasar di daerah pegunungan, membantu banyak anak meninggalkan pegunungan.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 孩子抬頭望著天空，想知道雲後面有什麼。
dialogue.pinyin: hái zi tái tóu wàng zhù tiān kōng ， xiǎng zhī dào yún hòu miàn yǒu shén me 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄊㄞˊ ㄊㄡˊ ㄨㄤˋ ㄓㄨˋ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄎㄨㄥ ， ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄩㄣˊ ㄏㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙ 。

dialogue.translation_en: The child looked up at the sky, wanting to know what was behind the clouds.
dialogue.translation_id: Anak itu menengadah ke langit, ingin tahu apa yang ada di balik awan-awan itu.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果沒有乾淨的開水，戶外活動中就容易出現健康問題。

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果你當時在場，情況可能會更清楚。

paragraphs.hanzi: 這位專家長期研究人工智能。

paragraphs.hanzi: 通過長期觀察，研究人員發現了關鍵規律，從而提高了預測的準確度。

paragraphs.translation_id: Melalui observasi jangka panjang, peneliti menemukan pola kunci sehingga meningkatkan akurasi prediksi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 三年以來，他一直在研究這個問題。

body: A short passage about item; project; (sports) event; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.hanzi: 對待安全問題，管理人員必須保持嚴肅態度。

paragraphs.translation_id: Silakan kirimkan bukti identitas dan dokumen terkait.

paragraphs.hanzi: 申請材料必須充足，否則工作人員可能會要求你補充資料。

paragraphs.translation_en: This study only recruits healthy women aged twenty to thirty.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penelitian ini hanya merekrut perempuan sehat berusia dua puluh hingga tiga puluh tahun.

paragraphs.hanzi: 长期的挫折使他重新思考自己的研究方向。

paragraphs.translation_id: Kemunduran jangka panjang membuatnya memikirkan kembali arah penelitiannya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他研究商业管理，希望以后自己开公司。

paragraphs.translation_en: He studies business management and hopes to start his own company in the future.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia sedang menempuh studi di bidang manajemen bisnis dan berharap dapat mendirikan perusahaannya sendiri di masa depan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 科学家正在研究如何利用细菌合成可降解材料。
paragraphs.pinyin: kē xué jiā zhèng zài yán jiū rú hé lì yòng xì jūn hé chéng kě jiàng jiě cái liào 。

paragraphs.translation_en: Scientists are studying how to use bacteria to synthesise biodegradable materials.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ilmuwan sedang mempelajari cara menggunakan bakteri untuk mensintesis bahan yang dapat terbiodegradasi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他对古文字特别感兴趣，常常去博物馆研究。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā duì gǔ wén zì tè bié gǎn xìng qù ， cháng cháng qù bó wù guǎn yán jiū 。

paragraphs.translation_id: Dia sangat tertarik pada tulisan kuno dan sering mengunjungi museum untuk mempelajarinya.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about research; a study; CL:項|项[xiang4]; to research; to look into.

paragraphs.hanzi: 真正成熟的人不是从不求助，而是知道什么时候需要别人支持。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng chéng shú de rén bú shì cóng bù qiú zhù ， ér shì zhī dào shén me shí hòu xū yào bié rén zhī chí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕㄨˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄓㄨˋ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄏㄡˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄓ ㄔˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: A truly mature person is not someone who never asks for help, but someone who knows when support is needed.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang yang benar-benar dewasa bukanlah orang yang tidak pernah meminta bantuan, tapi orang yang tahu kapan dukungan dibutuhkan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 别只说空话安慰别人，真正的帮助更重要。
paragraphs.pinyin: bié zhǐ shuō kōng huà ān wèi bié rén ， zhēn zhèng de bāng zhù gèng zhòng yào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄓˇ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄢ ㄨㄟˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ ㄍㄥˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Don’t just comfort people with empty words; real help is more important.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jangan hanya menghibur orang dengan kata-kata kosong; bantuan nyata lebih penting.

paragraphs.hanzi: 真正成熟的人不会过分在意一时的得失。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng chéng shú de rén bú huì guò fèn zài yì yī shí de dé shī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕㄨˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧˋ ㄧ ㄕˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄜˊ ㄕ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Truly mature people do not care too much about temporary gains and losses.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang yang benar-benar dewasa tidak terlalu peduli dengan keuntungan dan kerugian sementara.

paragraphs.hanzi: 父母希望她嫁给一个真正尊重她的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: fù mǔ xī wàng tā jià gěi yí gè zhēn zhèng zūn zhòng tā de rén 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄈㄨˋ ㄇㄨˇ ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄊㄚ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄍㄟˇ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜˋ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄨㄣ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Her parents hope she will marry someone who truly respects her.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang tuanya berharap dia akan menikah dengan seseorang yang benar-benar menghormatinya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 真正的朋友不多，遇到了就要珍惜。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu bù duō ， yù dào le jiù yào zhēn xī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ， ㄩˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄓㄣ ㄒㄧ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: True friends are not many; when you meet them, you should cherish them.
paragraphs.translation_id: Teman sejati tidak banyak; ketika kamu bertemu mereka, kamu harus menghargai mereka.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在这部小说里，真正的敌人不是别人，而是主人公自己的恐惧。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài zhè bù xiǎo shuō lǐ ， zhēn zhèng de dí rén bú shì bié rén ， ér shì zhǔ rén gōng zì jǐ de kǒng jù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄌㄧˇ ， ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄓㄨˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄎㄨㄥˇ ㄐㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: In this novel, the real enemy is not another person, but the main character’s own fear.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dalam novel ini, musuh sebenarnya bukanlah orang lain, melainkan ketakutan sang tokoh utama sendiri.

body: A short passage about genuine; real; true; really; indeed.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他决定告别过去的生活，去一个新的城市重新开始。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā jué dìng gào bié guò qù de shēng huó ， qù yí gè xīn de chéng shì chóng xīn kāi shǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ， ㄑㄩˋ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He decided to say goodbye to his past life and make a fresh start in a new city.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia memutuskan untuk melepaskan diri dari kehidupan lamanya dan memulai hidup baru di kota yang baru.

paragraphs.hanzi: 这篇文章引用的材料很杂，需要重新整理。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng yǐn yòng de cái liào hěn zá ， xū yào chóng xīn zhěng lǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄆㄧㄢ ㄨㄣˊ ㄓㄤ ㄧㄣˇ ㄩㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄗㄚˊ ， ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄓㄥˇ ㄌㄧˇ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The materials cited in this article are very mixed and need to be reorganized.
paragraphs.translation_id: Materi yang dikutip dalam artikel ini sangat beragam dan perlu ditata ulang.

paragraphs.hanzi: 合同到期以后，双方可以重新商量待遇。
paragraphs.pinyin: hé tóng dào qī yǐ hòu ， shuāng fāng kě yǐ chóng xīn shāng liáng dài yù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄑㄧ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄕㄨㄤ ㄈㄤ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄕㄤ ㄌㄧㄤˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: After the contract expires, both sides can discuss the terms again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah kontrak berakhir, kedua belah pihak dapat mendiskusikan kembali persyaratannya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在他最困难的时候，亲情给了他重新开始的力量。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài tā zuì kùn nán de shí hòu ， qīn qíng gěi le tā chóng xīn kāi shǐ de lì liàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄊㄚ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄢˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄑㄧㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄍㄟˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: At his most difficult time, family affection gave him the strength to start again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di saat tersulitnya, kasih sayang keluarga memberinya kekuatan untuk memulai kembali.

paragraphs.hanzi: 这次旅程让他重新思考了生活的意义。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè cì lǚ chéng ràng tā chóng xīn sī kǎo le shēng huó de yì yì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄌㄩˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄖㄤˋ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄙ ㄎㄠˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄧˋ ㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This journey made him rethink the meaning of life.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perjalanan ini membuatnya memikirkan kembali arti hidup.

paragraphs.hanzi: 这份资料把事件按公元年份重新排列，便于读者比较。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn zī liào bǎ shì jiàn àn gōng yuán nián fèn chóng xīn pái liè ， biàn yú dú zhě bǐ jiào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄚˇ ㄕˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄢˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄩㄢˊ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄈㄣˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄆㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄝˋ ， ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄩˊ ㄉㄨˊ ㄓㄜˇ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This material rearranges the events by AD year, making them easier for readers to compare.
paragraphs.translation_id: Materi ini menyusun ulang peristiwa-peristiwa berdasarkan tahun Masehi, sehingga memudahkan pembaca untuk membandingkannya.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 公司从那次事故中吸取教训，重新制定了安全流程。
dialogue.pinyin: gōng sī cóng nà cì shì gù zhōng xī qǔ jiào xùn ， chóng xīn zhì dìng le ān quán liú chéng 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄋㄚˋ ㄘˋ ㄕˋ ㄍㄨˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄒㄧ ㄑㄩˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄩㄣˋ ， ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄓˋ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄔㄥˊ 。
dialogue.translation: The company learned a lesson from that accident and drew up new safety procedures.
dialogue.translation_en: The company learned a lesson from that accident and drew up new safety procedures.
dialogue.translation_id: Perusahaan mengambil pelajaran dari kecelakaan itu dan menyusun prosedur keselamatan baru.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 这家公司由兄妹共同继承，管理权需要重新安排。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī yóu xiōng mèi gòng tóng jì chéng ， guǎn lǐ quán xū yào chóng xīn ān pái 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄧㄡˊ ㄒㄩㄥ ㄇㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄔㄥˊ ， ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄢ ㄆㄞˊ 。
dialogue.translation: This company was jointly inherited by the brother and sister, so management rights need to be rearranged.
dialogue.translation_en: This company was jointly inherited by the brother and sister, so management rights need to be rearranged.
dialogue.translation_id: Perusahaan ini diwarisi bersama oleh kakak beradik tersebut, sehingga hak pengelolaannya perlu diatur ulang.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 我们要么接受现有条件，要么重新寻找合作方。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ men yào me jiē shòu xiàn yǒu tiáo jiàn ， yào me chóng xīn xún zhǎo hé zuò fāng 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄧㄠˋ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄝ ㄕㄡˋ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄊㄧㄠˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ， ㄧㄠˋ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄒㄩㄣˊ ㄓㄠˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄈㄤ 。
dialogue.translation: We either accept the current conditions or look for a new partner.
dialogue.translation_en: We either accept the current conditions or look for a new partner.
dialogue.translation_id: Kita bisa memilih untuk menerima kondisi saat ini atau mencari mitra baru.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 这次失败促使他重新思考自己的学习方法。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè cì shī bài cù shǐ tā chóng xīn sī kǎo zì jǐ de xué xí fāng fǎ 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄕ ㄅㄞˋ ㄘㄨˋ ㄕˇ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄙ ㄎㄠˇ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧˊ ㄈㄤ ㄈㄚˇ 。
dialogue.translation: This failure prompted him to rethink his own study methods.
dialogue.translation_en: This failure prompted him to rethink his own study methods.
dialogue.translation_id: Kegagalan ini mendorongnya untuk memikirkan kembali metode belajarnya sendiri.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 他失业以后，没有放弃，而是重新学习新技能。
dialogue.pinyin: tā shī yè yǐ hòu ， méi yǒu fàng qì ， ér shì chóng xīn xué xí xīn jì néng 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄕ ㄧㄝˋ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄤˋ ㄑㄧˋ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄐㄧˋ ㄋㄥˊ 。
dialogue.translation: After losing his job, he did not give up but started learning new skills again.
dialogue.translation_en: After losing his job, he did not give up but started learning new skills again.
dialogue.translation_id: Setelah kehilangan pekerjaannya, ia tidak menyerah, melainkan mulai mempelajari keterampilan baru lagi.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 我们需要重新组合这些资料。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào chóng xīn zǔ hé zhè xiē zī liào 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄗㄨˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄝ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ 。
dialogue.translation: We need to recombine these materials.
dialogue.translation_en: We need to recombine these materials.
dialogue.translation_id: Kita perlu menggabungkan kembali bahan-bahan ini.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about again; once more; re-.

paragraphs.hanzi: 这所大学在高等教育改革中试行了更加灵活的课程制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè suǒ dà xué zài gāo děng jiào yù gǎi gé zhōng shì xíng le gèng jiā líng huó de kè chéng zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄍㄠ ㄉㄥˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄩˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄍㄜˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄍㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄌㄧㄥˊ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄎㄜˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: This university has trialled a more flexible curriculum system in higher education reform.
paragraphs.translation_id: Universitas ini telah menguji coba sistem kurikulum yang lebih fleksibel dalam reformasi pendidikan tinggi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 这些文书的出土，为研究地方制度提供了第一手材料。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiē wén shū de chū tǔ ， wèi yán jiū dì fāng zhì dù tí gōng le dì yī shǒu cái liào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄝ ㄨㄣˊ ㄕㄨ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄨ ㄊㄨˇ ， ㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄉㄧˋ ㄈㄤ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ㄕㄡˇ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The discovery of these documents provides first-hand material for the study of local institutions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penemuan dokumen-dokumen ini menyediakan bahan primer untuk studi mengenai lembaga-lembaga lokal.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学校正在制订新的安全制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: xué xiào zhèng zài zhì dìng xīn de ān quán zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The school is formulating a new safety system.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sekolah sedang merumuskan sistem keselamatan baru.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他并不反对试点，只是提醒大家不要低估其中的制度利弊。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā bìng bù fǎn duì shì diǎn ， zhǐ shì tí xǐng dà jiā bú yào dī gū qí zhōng de zhì dù lì bì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄕˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ， ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄧ ㄍㄨ ㄑㄧˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄌㄧˋ ㄅㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He is not against the pilot scheme; he is merely reminding everyone not to underestimate the institutional pros and cons involved.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia tidak menentang program percontohan tersebut; dia hanya mengingatkan semua pihak agar tidak meremehkan pro dan kontra kelembagaan yang terkait.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他曾在德国就读三年，因此对当地教育制度很熟悉。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā céng zài dé guó jiù dú sān nián ， yīn cǐ duì dāng dì jiào yù zhì dù hěn shú xī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄘㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄨˊ ㄙㄢ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ， ㄧㄣ ㄘˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄤ ㄉㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄩˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄕㄨˊ ㄒㄧ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He once studied in Germany for three years, so he is very familiar with the local education system.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ia pernah belajar di Jerman selama tiga tahun, sehingga ia sangat paham dengan sistem pendidikan setempat.

paragraphs.hanzi: 政府在沿海地区率先试行新的垃圾分类制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ zài yán hǎi dì qū shuài xiān shì xíng xīn de lā jī fēn lèi zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄏㄞˇ ㄉㄧˋ ㄑㄩ ㄕㄨㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄚ ㄐㄧ ㄈㄣ ㄌㄟˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The government first piloted the new waste-sorting system in coastal areas.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah pertama kali menguji coba sistem pemilahan sampah yang baru di daerah pesisir.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 这块土地太肥，种香草反而容易长得过旺。
dialogue.pinyin: zhè kuài tǔ dì tài féi ， zhǒng xiāng cǎo fǎn ér róng yì zhǎng dé guò wàng 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄊㄨˇ ㄉㄧˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄈㄟˊ ， ㄓㄨㄥˇ ㄒㄧㄤ ㄘㄠˇ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄖㄨㄥˊ ㄧˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄉㄜˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄨㄤˋ 。
dialogue.translation: This piece of land is too fertile; herbs planted there may actually grow too vigorously.
dialogue.translation_en: This piece of land is too fertile; herbs planted there may actually grow too vigorously.
dialogue.translation_id: Lahan ini terlalu subur; tanaman herbal yang ditanam di sana justru mungkin tumbuh terlalu subur.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 此刻的沉默并不代表同意，反而可能隐藏着更深的不满。
dialogue.pinyin: cǐ kè de chén mò bìng bù dài biǎo tóng yì ， fǎn ér kě néng yǐn cáng zhe gēng shēn de bù mǎn 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄘˇ ㄎㄜˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄣˊ ㄇㄛˋ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄞˋ ㄅㄧㄠˇ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄧˋ ， ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄧㄣˇ ㄘㄤˊ ㄓㄜ˙ ㄍㄥ ㄕㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄇㄢˇ 。
dialogue.translation: The silence at this moment does not mean agreement; on the contrary, it may hide deeper dissatisfaction.
dialogue.translation_en: The silence at this moment does not mean agreement; on the contrary, it may hide deeper dissatisfaction.
dialogue.translation_id: Keheningan saat ini tidak berarti persetujuan; sebaliknya, hal ini mungkin menyembunyikan ketidakpuasan yang lebih dalam.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.hanzi: 如果分工过细，员工反而可能失去对整体流程的理解。
dialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ fēn gōng guò xì ， yuán gōng fǎn ér kě néng shī qù duì zhěng tǐ liú chéng de lǐ jiě 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄈㄣ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄒㄧˋ ， ㄩㄢˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄕ ㄑㄩˋ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄥˇ ㄊㄧˇ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ 。
dialogue.translation: If the division of labour is too detailed, employees may instead lose their understanding of the overall process.
dialogue.translation_en: If the division of labour is too detailed, employees may instead lose their understanding of the overall process.
dialogue.translation_id: Jika pembagian kerja terlalu rinci, karyawan malah bisa kehilangan pemahaman terhadap keseluruhan proses.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.hanzi: 如果企业的治理结构长期失衡，管理效率反而会倒退。
dialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ qǐ yè de zhì lǐ jié gòu cháng qī shī héng ， guǎn lǐ xiào lǜ fǎn ér huì dào tuì 。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄑㄧˇ ㄧㄝˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄡˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄕ ㄏㄥˊ ， ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄩˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄊㄨㄟˋ 。
dialogue.translation: If a company's governance structure remains imbalanced for a long time, management efficiency may actually regress.
dialogue.translation_en: If a company's governance structure remains imbalanced for a long time, management efficiency may actually regress.

body: A short passage about system, institution.

paragraphs.hanzi: 市民对改善交通的需求十分急切，政府不能再拖延。
paragraphs.pinyin: shì mín duì gǎi shàn jiāo tōng de xū qiú shí fēn jí qiè ， zhèng fǔ bù néng zài tuō yán 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˋ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄕㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄒㄩ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄕˊ ㄈㄣ ㄐㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄝˋ ， ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄊㄨㄛ ㄧㄢˊ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: Citizens have a very urgent need for transport improvements, and the government cannot delay any longer.
paragraphs.translation_id: Masyarakat mempunyai kebutuhan yang sangat mendesak akan perbaikan transportasi, dan pemerintah tidak dapat menundanya lebih lama lagi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 政府按照地形和人口密度重新划分了几个行政区域。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ àn zhào dì xíng hé rén kǒu mì dù chóng xīn huà fēn le jǐ gè xíng zhèng qū yù 。

paragraphs.translation_en: The government redivided several administrative regions according to terrain and population density.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah membagi kembali beberapa wilayah administratif menurut medan dan kepadatan penduduk.

paragraphs.hanzi: 市政府号召市民减少一次性塑料制品的使用。
paragraphs.pinyin: shì zhèng fǔ hào zhào shì mín jiǎn shǎo yí cì xìng sù liào zhì pǐn de shǐ yòng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄏㄠˋ ㄓㄠˋ ㄕˋ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄕㄠˇ ㄧˊ ㄘˋ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄙㄨˋ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄓˋ ㄆㄧㄣˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˇ ㄩㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The city government called on residents to reduce the use of disposable plastic products.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah kota mengimbau warga untuk mengurangi penggunaan produk plastik sekali pakai.

paragraphs.hanzi: 政府希望通过改革提高公共服务的效率。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ xī wàng tōng guò gǎi gé tí gāo gōng gòng fú wù de xiào lǜ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄍㄜˊ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄠ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄈㄨˊ ㄨˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The government hopes to improve the efficiency of public services through reform.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah berharap dapat meningkatkan efisiensi pelayanan publik melalui reformasi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 政府开始清理河道垃圾，以改善水质。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ kāi shǐ qīng lǐ hé dào lā jī ， yǐ gǎi shàn shuǐ zhì 。

paragraphs.translation_en: The government began clearing rubbish from the river channel to improve water quality.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah mulai membersihkan sampah dari saluran sungai untuk meningkatkan kualitas air.

paragraphs.hanzi: 政府把更多资金投入到公共交通。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ bǎ gèng duō zī jīn tóu rù dào gōng gòng jiāo tōng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄍㄥˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄗ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄡˊ ㄖㄨˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄊㄨㄥ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: The government is investing more funds into public transport.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah menginvestasikan lebih banyak dana untuk transportasi umum.

steps.title: Summary
body: A short passage about government; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.hanzi: 西餐桌上如果没有叉子，我反而不知道该怎么吃。
paragraphs.pinyin: xī cān zhuō shàng rú guǒ méi yǒu chā zi ， wǒ fǎn ér bù zhī dào gāi zěn me chī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧ ㄘㄢ ㄓㄨㄛ ㄕㄤˋ ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄔㄚ ㄗ˙ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄍㄞ ㄗㄣˇ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄔ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: At a Western dining table, if there is no fork, I actually do not know how to eat.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di meja makan bergaya Barat, kalau tidak ada garpu, jujur saja, saya tidak tahu cara makan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果不懂得配合，两个人一起划反而会更累。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ bù dǒng de pèi hé ， liǎng gè rén yì qǐ huà fǎn ér huì gèng lèi 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄆㄟˋ ㄏㄜˊ ， ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄧˋ ㄑㄧˇ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄥˋ ㄌㄟˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: If they do not know how to cooperate, two people paddling together will actually be more tiring.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika tidak tahu cara bekerja sama, dua orang yang mengayuh bersama justru akan lebih melelahkan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 作客海外多年以后，他反而更清楚自己文化身份中的复杂性。
paragraphs.pinyin: zuò kè hǎi wài duō nián yǐ hòu ， tā fǎn ér gèng qīng chǔ zì jǐ wén huà shēn fèn zhōng de fù zá xìng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄨㄞˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄊㄚ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄔㄨˇ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄨㄣˊ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄕㄣ ㄈㄣˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄈㄨˋ ㄗㄚˊ ㄒㄧㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: After spending many years overseas as a guest, he became even clearer about the complexity of his own cultural identity.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah menghabiskan waktu bertahun-tahun sebagai tamu di luar negeri, ia semakin memahami kompleksitas identitas budayanya sendiri.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在这座高成本城市，单身青年的住房压力反而更加突出。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài zhè zuò gāo chéng běn chéng shì ， dān shēn qīng nián de zhù fáng yā lì fǎn ér gèng jiā tū chū 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄍㄠ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕˋ ， ㄉㄢ ㄕㄣ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨˋ ㄈㄤˊ ㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄊㄨ ㄔㄨ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: In this high-cost city, housing pressure on single young people is even more pronounced.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di kota berbiaya tinggi ini, tekanan terhadap perumahan bagi kaum muda lajang bahkan lebih besar lagi.

paragraphs.hanzi: 他明明很感激对方，却说得别扭，反而像是在抱怨。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā míng míng hěn gǎn jī duì fāng ， què shuō dé biè niǔ ， fǎn ér xiàng shì zài bào yuàn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄍㄢˇ ㄐㄧ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄈㄤ ， ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄉㄜˊ ㄅㄧㄝˋ ㄋㄧㄡˇ ， ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄕˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄩㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: He was obviously grateful to the other person, but expressed it so awkwardly that it sounded more like a complaint.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia jelas berterima kasih kepada orang lain, tapi mengungkapkannya dengan canggung sehingga terdengar lebih seperti keluhan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果主人公过于完美，读者反而难以相信他的成长具有真实的重量。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ zhǔ rén gōng guò yú wán měi ， dú zhě fǎn ér nán yǐ xiāng xìn tā de chéng zhǎng jù yǒu zhēn shí de zhòng liàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄓㄨˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄩˊ ㄨㄢˊ ㄇㄟˇ ， ㄉㄨˊ ㄓㄜˇ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄋㄢˊ ㄧˇ ㄒㄧㄤ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄥˊ ㄓㄤˇ ㄐㄩˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄓㄣ ㄕˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.translation_en: If the protagonist is too perfect, readers will instead find it hard to believe that his growth has real weight.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika tokoh utamanya terlalu sempurna, pembaca justru akan sulit mempercayai bahwa perkembangannya memiliki makna yang sesungguhnya.
